records.name: Angular UButton
records.purpose: Native action button with loading/disabled gating and icon/label rendering.
records.surface: Root @ultimate/ng exports UButton through src/index.ts -> ./button. There is no @ultimate/ng/button manifest subpath. Selector u-button; standalone component extends UBaseComponent. Signal inputs include label, icon, iconPos, loading, disabled, severity, raised, rounded, text, outlined, size and fluid; outputs onClick, onFocus and onBlur. Private/protected styling helpers belong to this record, not additional products. Inherits dt: Record<string, unknown>|undefined and unstyled: boolean|undefined from UBaseComponent; these declared inputs are not evidence that unstyled suppresses registration. Root @ultimate/ng re-exports this component. No dedicated manifest subpath; root entry only. Style module exports and class-parameter interfaces are source-only internals, not barrel exports or independent rendered components. CSS imports @ultimate/uix-styles/button; local buttonStyleModule supplies css/classes. Theme identity button matches componentName and Aura components registry; dt() resolves those token references via base registration. BUTTON_METADATA associates ng sourcePath with this source; its native-event convention is not absence of Angular outputs. Owned source-only declarations: ButtonClassesParams, buttonStyleModule. ButtonClassesParams describes hasIcon/label/loading/severity/raised/rounded/text/outlined/size/fluid/iconPos for local root/icon class resolution.
